Every construct proposed adds an obligation that is actually discharged. The anti-pattern is measured rather than hypothetical: at 84d276e7 a function declaring fx write() over a region that does not exist, on a body that touches nothing, certifies at L3 — the row is unchecked in both directions. Surface that certifies without checking is worse than no surface, because it converts an unproven claim into a passing certificate.
